answer_text: RI stands for Information Retrieval, a branch of computer science focused on acquiring, organizing, storing, searching, and selecting relevant information to meet specific user needs. To understand this, you first need to know that 'information' refers to various types of data such as text documents, images, videos, sensor data, etc. The explosion in the production of these diverse data forms has made RI increasingly important because massive amounts of information continue to grow and user demands for information also increase.
